# Networking

Networking allows containers to communicate with each other and the outside world. It provides mechanisms for isolating container traffic, exposing container ports, and managing DNS resolution. Docker networking uses drivers to create different types of networks, enabling flexibility in how containers are connected and how they interact with the host system and other networks.
